description: Integrate gateway dispatcher into httpapi/server.go. When dispatch.mode=gateway, the genericFlowHandler routes requests through Dispatcher instead of running flow.Interpreter inline. Add POST /internal/execute endpoint for cross-group calls (worker→gateway→worker). The API remains transparent to consumers - same request/response format.
steps: Modify /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/httpapi/server.go Deps struct: add Dispatcher *gateway.Dispatcher field (nil when dispatch.mode=inline), add DispatchConfig *config.DispatchConfig field

Modify genericFlowHandler in server.go: after resolving flow via store.ActiveFlow, check if deps.DispatchConfig.Mode == config.DispatchGateway. If gateway mode: extract group from flow (fv.Group, fallback to config.DefaultGroup), call deps.Dispatcher.Dispatch(ctx, fv.FlowID, group, input), convert worker.ExecuteResponse to HTTP response. If inline mode: existing flow.Interpreter.Run logic unchanged

Add internal execute handler for cross-group calls: create function internalExecuteHandler(dispatcher, store, deps) returning http.HandlerFunc. Handler: 1) Decode worker.ExecuteRequest from body, 2) Resolve flow via store.ActiveFlow to get group, 3) Call dispatcher.Dispatch, 4) Encode worker.ExecuteResponse. Register as 'POST /internal/execute' in mount(mux) before the catch-all

Modify /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/cmd/engine/main.go run() function: 1) Call config.LoadDispatchConfig(), 2) If mode=gateway: build k8s client via rest.InClusterConfig or kubeconfig, create WorkerRegistry, start registry.Watch(ctx), create WorkerClient, create Dispatcher, 3) Pass Dispatcher and DispatchConfig to httpapi.Deps, 4) Add defer for registry.Close()

Add k8s client building to cmd/engine/main.go: create buildK8sClient() function that tries rest.InClusterConfig() first (running in-cluster), falls back to clientcmd.BuildConfigFromFlags for local dev with KUBECONFIG env var, returns nil with warning log if neither works (allows inline mode without K8s)

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/httpapi/dispatch_test.go with tests: TestGenericFlowHandler_InlineMode verifies interpreter is called when mode=inline, TestGenericFlowHandler_GatewayMode verifies dispatcher is called when mode=gateway, TestInternalExecute_Success verifies cross-group routing works
acceptance_criteria: With DISPATCH_MODE=inline (default), requests execute via flow.Interpreter (existing behavior)
With DISPATCH_MODE=gateway, requests route through gateway.Dispatcher to workers
POST /internal/execute endpoint available for worker-to-gateway cross-group calls
Same request/response format regardless of dispatch mode (transparent to API consumers)
Engine starts successfully even without K8s access when mode=inline
